events.text: George Frideric Handel completes his oratorio Messiah.
Britain switches to the Gregorian calendar: 14 September follows 2 September.
Francis Scott Key writes the poem that becomes "The Star-Spangled Banner".
Theodore Roosevelt becomes U.S. President after McKinley's death.
Luna 2 becomes the first spacecraft to reach the surface of the Moon.
Estonia votes in a referendum to join the European Union.

births.text: Alexander von Humboldt, German explorer and scientist

deaths.text: Grace Kelly, American actress and Princess of Monaco
